title: hydrangea serrata var. stellata
intro: Hydrangea serrata var. stellata, commonly known as Bigleaf Mountain Hydrangea or Stellata Hydrangea, is a compact, flowering shrub native to mountainous regions in East Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea serrata var. stellata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
